description: This file defines the GatewayConnectivityCoordinator class responsible for managing gateway endpoint connectivity, including tracking endpoint states, handling URL resolution, and coordinating refreshes when endpoint changes occur.

classes.name: GatewayConnectivityCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class managing gateway connectivity state and endpoint updates using asynchronous tasks and observing state changes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the endpoint subscription task to listen for gateway state updates.

methods.name: handleEndpointState
methods.description: Handles different endpoint states by updating internal properties and triggering refreshes if the endpoint URL changes.

methods.name: hostLabel
methods.description: Generates a host label string from a URL, including port if available.
